messages.content: I've been thinking about whether I actually want kids or just feel like I'm supposed to want them.
Honestly, that's a genuinely important distinction to sit with before deciding anything. What makes you unsure which one it is?
I don't feel excited when I picture it, more like obligation.
That's honestly worth taking seriously, actually - obligation-driven decisions about something this permanent tend to create real resentment later if you follow through anyway.
I've never really let myself admit that out loud before.
That's a genuinely big thing to say honestly, even just to yourself. Give yourself room to actually explore what you want, separate from what's expected.
